about.heading: About Sankara Insurance Group
about.body:
Sankara Insurance Group, Inc. is an insurance agency based in Kissimmee, Florida. We help individuals and families look at their auto, home, life and health insurance options and explain how each type of coverage works, so you can choose what fits your situation and budget.

Tell us a little about what you need and we will follow up.

items.title: Auto Insurance
items.description: Coverage for the cars you drive and the people who drive them.
items.detail:
Auto insurance helps pay for damage you cause to other people and their property and, depending on the coverages you choose, for damage to your own vehicle and injuries to you and your passengers. Florida sets its own minimum requirements, and many drivers choose higher limits or add coverages such as collision, comprehensive and uninsured motorist protection.

The right mix depends on your vehicle, how you use it, and what you would be comfortable paying out of pocket after an accident. Request a quote and we can walk through the options with you.

items.title: Home Insurance
items.description: Protection for your house, your belongings and your liability.
items.detail:
Homeowners insurance typically covers damage to the structure of your home, your personal belongings, extra living expenses if you cannot stay in the home after a covered loss, and liability if someone is injured on your property.

In Florida, wind and hurricane coverage, deductibles and flood protection deserve special attention. Flood damage is generally not covered by a standard homeowners policy and is usually a separate policy. It is worth understanding how each of these works before you decide.

items.title: Life Insurance
items.description: Financial protection for the people who depend on you.
items.detail:
Life insurance pays a benefit to the people you name if you pass away. Term life insurance covers a set number of years, while permanent life insurance is designed to last your lifetime and can build cash value.

How much coverage makes sense depends on your income, debts, family and goals. Tell us about your situation and we can talk through the common ways to approach it.

items.title: Health Insurance
items.description: Help understanding your health coverage options.
items.detail:
Health insurance helps pay for medical care, and plans differ in monthly cost, deductibles, copays and which doctors and hospitals are in the network.

Choosing a plan means weighing those trade-offs against how you and your family use care. Request a quote or send us your questions and we will talk through the options that apply to you.
